instructions: Read this roster before every scheduled reading run; work only inside the registered slot.

For book assignment, owner, claim, in-progress/completed status, and resume point, the latest accepted main book-registry.json is authoritative; current_book and completed_books in this roster are personal mirrored summaries, not a competing claim source.

When registry and roster book fields differ, follow an unambiguous registry entry: continue a book marked in_progress with owner_agent_id set to the current agent and claim.state held, even if the roster summary is stale; do not read a registry-completed book unless the user explicitly requests a reread. The responsible agent's maintainer syncs that agent's roster; never edit another agent's personal entry.

If the registry itself has an ambiguous owner/status, duplicate claim, inaccessible latest main, or conflicting/unclear active_session, stop before reading and notify the user; a roster summary mismatch alone is not a reason to stop.

If no new title is specified, continue the agent's last unfinished book as assigned in the registry; after completion, select the most recently added unread, unclaimed book on the user's bookshelf. Do not default to selecting by author.
Before starting, check the latest accepted registry, roster, and communication record for the assigned slot, active task, and conflicts; do not start if registry ownership or active state is unclear.

For any failure, interruption, access block, conflict, or uncertain result, notify the user immediately in the current Cue private conversation with what actually happened and the next recovery step. A repository update alone is not a notification.
At run start, set run_status to running and record the actual start time, current book, and slot in agent-communication.md.
At run end, update run_status, actual end time, book_completion, and a minimal output reference in both this roster and agent-communication.md.

At each reading run start, send the user a brief direct Cue message naming the slot and book. After each run, send a direct Cue result with actual duration, confirmed pages/page range or chapters, and a concise mind-map summary based only on content actually read.
If exact page count is unavailable, say so and report confirmed chapters, progress, or page-turn count instead of estimating. Report interrupted or unstarted runs and recovery steps promptly.

Every configured time slot is an independent reading run and must read even if another slot on the same date completed. Never overlap an active run; if another run's status is unclear, verify it is no longer active before starting, or report the unresolved conflict.
Same-book work from multiple slots on one date is merged into a single date note; different books read on the same date each get their own date note.
If an agent misses a slot, record that fact; do not overlap another agent's window or claim the missed run happened.
Use unknown/needs-confirmation rather than guessing a book, completion state, or execution result.

For each actual reading run, select a random target duration from 7 to 15 minutes inclusive; adapt to comprehension and reading more. Report actual elapsed duration separately; do not treat a planned target or browser window as platform-confirmed effective reading time.
This public file records only minimal coordination metadata; never include passwords, tokens, private messages, or book-note content.
